integrity: Self-contained proof of the character from an explicit fixed-point orbit construction and a published sphere-wedge theorem; exact standalone independent computational corroboration of small cases.
scientific_limitations: Only rational color-permutation homology is classified; no integral lattice or combined cycle-color symmetry is asserted. Published nonequivariant cycle-product homotopy is an input. Equivalent unindexed work may exist.
title: The complete color-symmetry character of three-periodic cycle-product homology
